use: Sign in with a code, confirm an email address or phone number.
anatomy: Boxes (Code digit: Empty, Filled, Focus, Error, Disabled). With 6 characters: two groups of 3 with a dash between them.
reactProps: Two groups with a dash. Default true for length 6. Visual only.
behaviour: Anything that is not a digit is ignored. Pasting the whole code works.
a11y: One input with autocomplete="one-time-code" and inputmode="numeric". The boxes are aria-hidden.
content: Say where the code was sent and how long it is valid.
dont: Six separate inputs: that breaks pasting and screen readers.
name: Verification code
summary: One-time code (2FA, email check) shown as boxes. In code it is one input, so typing, pasting and SMS autofill all work.
